ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a food chain, titled “Food Chain”. The arrows show the energy/food flow: Sun points to Leaves, Leaves points to Cricket, Cricket points to Frog, Frog points to Snake, Snake points to Hawk, and Hawk points to Mushrooms. Leaves is labeled Producer, Cricket, Frog, Snake, and Hawk are labeled Consumer, and Mushrooms is labeled Decomposer. Reasoning: The question asks which organisms are herbivores. Herbivores are consumers that eat plants or producers. In the figure, Cricket obtains food/energy from Leaves, and Leaves is the producer, so the herbivore in the food chain is cricket.
